name: Lucide icons
summary: The default icon set for shadcn and for most of the 109 AI components here (components.json sets iconLibrary to lucide).

steps: Import icons individually so tree-shaking keeps the bundle small: import { Camera, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react".
Icon naming guidance for design work lives in the icons craft reference (references/icons.md).

files.role: Typical lucide-react usage inside a button

notes: All icons accept className for Tailwind sizing (size-4) and stroke-width for weight. Mark decorative icons aria-hidden="true".
